title: Head-Up Display Experience
summary: Feedback on the G70 head-up display centers on appreciation for the feature and navigation presentation, alongside complaints about daytime visibility and confusing graphics, with many fragments too brief or comparative to classify cleanly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the head-up display as a liked or loved feature, especially when it shows navigation directions clearly in the driver's line of sight.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on the head-up display being hard to see in daytime conditions and on information graphics or layout that feel complicated.

mixed.summary: The mixed review asks for a simpler process related to the display key and iPhone integration, combining a feature request with dissatisfaction about complexity.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention comparisons, intermittent display behavior, size or placement preferences, and very short references that do not provide enough context for a clear sentiment label.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are undetermined or very brief, which limits clear interpretation of customer sentiment.
The topic includes both head-up display performance and display key or phone-process comments, so the cluster is not fully uniform.
Only a subset of topic fragments is shown, so examples may be insufficient to capture the full range of feedback.
